_comment: Content Wave C2+C3: Zevara Sunderscale, Oldblood Drake Watch Captain of Liscor, posted at the gate. Canon (wiki.wanderinginn.com/Zevara): light-blue scales, a scar down the left of her jaw, tall; dry, perpetually overworked, rigidly procedural, refuses bribes, no personal life (six weeks' leave in ten years); her Senior Guardsmen are Relc (a [Spearmaster]) and Klbkch (an Antinium). C3: the old generic persuade branch is now the Q1 'Something in the Cisterns' TALK path -- a Watch-sweep persuade CHAIN (sweep_pitch -> sweep_argue -> swept), gated VISIBLE once heard_about_cisterns is banked (the quest is open) and HIDDEN once watch_swept_cisterns is banked (per the sergeant precedent). The winning option banks persuaded_someone ([Diplomat] identity feed, same as watch_crate) + watch_swept_cisterns + resolved_the_cisterns (Q1 beat-1 convergence) and remove_entity shield_spiders (the Watch clears the nest -- remove_entity precedent). The hub gains a post-completion WITNESS text_variant gated on resolved_the_cisterns (any path). The spec's 'gate_guard defers to her' beat stays on ZEVARA'S side (the 'authority' node) rather than editing gate_guard, which gate_district_walkthrough + social_loop assert VERBATIM. NO canonical script asserted this graph before C3 (C2's probe was deleted); cisterns_talk is its first canonical coverage. Opacity rule: class NAME only, no stats, no counter numerals.

hub.speaker: Zevara
hub.text: Watch Captain Zevara. If this is a report, keep it short; if it's a complaint, keep it shorter. I've been on since before the gate opened and I'll be on after it shuts.

text_variants.text: The thing under the market — I hear it's handled. Good. I sleep worse than you'd think over not knowing what's beneath my own streets. However you settled it, the Watch owes you a quiet night. Don't tell the others I said so.

options.text: The cisterns under the market — I need the Watch to sweep them.

shift.speaker: Zevara
shift.text: Ten years of long shifts. Six weeks of leave across all of them — do the arithmetic and then don't ask why I look like this. My Senior Guardsmen are a spearmaster who won't stop talking and an Antinium who won't start, and somehow the wall still stands. Don't tell either of them the streak's holding. They'll take the credit.

options.text: The guard on the gate speaks well of you.
I'll let you get back to it.

authority.speaker: Zevara
authority.text: He should. I signed his posting and I read his reports — both of them, the real one and the one where nothing happened. Liscor's Watch runs on people who'd rather stand a boring gate than let an interesting one through. Long may it bore us.

sweep_pitch.speaker: Zevara
sweep_pitch.text: Sweep the cisterns. You know what a sweep costs? Six Watchmen off the wall, lanterns, a healer on standby, and a form in triplicate explaining to the Council why the wall was six thin. Give me one reason worth the ink.

options.text: If it's under the city and it's moving, it's already Watch business — I'm just the one telling you before it's an emergency instead of a form.

sweep_argue.speaker: Zevara
sweep_argue.text: ...Before it's an emergency. Hm. You argue like someone who's read a casualty report. Fine — make it plain. What am I actually sending them into?

options.text: A nest. Silver-backed spiders, crept up from the Dungeon. Small now. It won't be small next month.

swept.speaker: Zevara
swept.text: Spiders from the Dungeon. Wonderful. That's exactly the small-now-large-later I'd rather pay for in overtime than in funerals. Consider it swept — I'll pull a squad at dusk and burn the silk out before it spreads. You did right bringing it to me clean, before it had teeth. Go tell whoever set you on this that the Watch has it. And — good work. That's rarer from my side of the gate than you'd think.
